title: UPSSSC Junior Engineer Revised Answer Key 2026 – Out
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
vacancyDetails: Revised / final answer key for JE (Civil) mains after objection review
qualification: Diploma / Degree in Civil Engineering as per UPSSSC JE notification
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials for login, photo ID for record
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open Notice Board / Revised Answer Key for JE Civil
3. Download Revised Answer Key PDF and master question paper
4. Compare with your responses
5. Result will be based on revised final key
shortDescription: UPSSSC JE (Civil) Revised Answer Key 2026 out on 20 July for mains held on 3 May 2026. Download from upsssc.gov.in.
content:
UPSSSC has published the Revised / Final Answer Key for Junior Engineer (Civil) Main Examination under Advt. 08-Exam/2024 on 20 July 2026.

Mains exam: 3 May 2026. Provisional key objections closed around 10 May 2026.

Download PDF from upsssc.gov.in. Final result will be prepared on this revised key.
